evals.name: restructures-previous-round-faithfully-quoting-terms
evals.expected_output: Fires on 'make this clear' with an empty argument, targets the previous assistant response (a dense round of several cross-referenced questions), and restructures it: one chunk per decision, each chunk carrying the original question number as a back-link, and each recommendation's operative terms quoted verbatim rather than paraphrased. Does not lower the reading level or replace terms with plain-language substitutes.
expectations: Targets the previous assistant response without asking what to digest
Splits the content into one-decision-at-a-time chunks
Each chunk preserves the original item's own number/identifier as a back-link
Operative terms of each recommendation appear verbatim, not paraphrased
Does not simplify or lower the altitude of the content

evals.name: declares-omissions-and-states-lens
evals.prompt: help me digest this — I can't parse it
evals.expected_output: Restructures the target and honors the remaining fidelity rules: anything from the original not carried into the digest is named in an explicit 'left out' note rather than silently dropped, and the digest closes by stating it is a lens — final answers are validated against the original text, not the restructuring.
expectations: Explicitly names anything omitted from the original rather than dropping it silently
Closes with a line stating the digest is a lens and to validate answers against the original
Keeps every decision the original held (no decisions lost to compression)

evals.name: artifact-forward-decision-table-two-numbering-systems
evals.prompt: break this down, this is a wall of text
evals.expected_output: For decision-dense content, renders a decision table with numbered rows and the columns item | recommendation | alternative | what-you're-deciding. The row number (the digest's own) is used for answer-mapping; the item column carries the original identifier as a back-link — the two numbering systems stay distinct. Recommendation and alternative cells carry verbatim operative terms. If the Artifact surface is available it publishes an HTML artifact (after loading artifact-design); otherwise it degrades to a local HTML file or structured terminal markdown.
expectations: Produces a decision table with the columns item | recommendation | alternative | what-you're-deciding
Uses distinct numbering: the digest's own row number for answer-mapping and the original item number as a back-link
Recommendation/alternative cells carry verbatim operative terms, not paraphrase
Selects the render medium (published artifact / local HTML file / terminal markdown) by artifact-surface availability and content size

evals.name: boundary-does-not-lower-altitude-for-explain-request
evals.prompt: explain this simply, ELI5 — I don't get what the previous message means
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as an altitude request (plain-language / ELI5 comprehension gap), which is education:explain's lane, not a structure problem. Does not respond by lowering the reading level or substituting an analogy under the guise of digesting; either routes to the plain-language explainer or, if it proceeds, holds altitude fixed and only restructures — never both.
expectations: Does not treat an ELI5 / 'explain simply' request as a cue to lower the content's altitude
Recognizes the altitude-vs-structure boundary and routes plain-language requests to education:explain
If it acts at all, it changes arrangement only and preserves precision and reading level

evals.name: explicit-target-overrides-and-defines-session-jargon
evals.prompt: /adhd:digest the design memo you wrote three messages ago
evals.expected_output: Uses the explicit target (the named earlier message) instead of the immediately previous response, re-reads that artifact's actual text, and restructures it — including a short glossary that defines the session-local shorthand it used (coined terms, internal labels) in plain words at the same altitude, without simplifying the concepts those terms name.
expectations: Honors the explicit target rather than defaulting to the immediately previous message
Re-reads the actual artifact text rather than working from memory of it
Includes a glossary defining session-local jargon in plain words
Defines the shorthand without lowering the altitude of the underlying concept
